newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Profit-taking in Altera, Atmel.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Profit-taking in Altera, Atmel.

text.p: Investors took advantage of sharp moves in Atmel Corp and Altera Corp shares by taking profits in the options, traders said Thursday.
Atmel shares fell in heavy trading after the company posted an increase in third quarter profits.
But traders said the stock was hit by the company's warning that its fourth quarter revenue and profit would be flat with the third quarter numbers.
"A lot of people are taking profits in their options right now," one trader said. "There are very few opening trades."
The Atmel October 30 call, down 1-7/8 at 2-5/8, traded more than 1,500 contracts. Its open interest was about 3,365.
The corresponding put, which was down 1/8 at 7/16, traded about 1,300.
At 1125 CDT (1625 GMT), Atmel shares were down 1-7/8 at 32-1/4 after hitting 30 in early trade. More than eight million shares changed hands.
Traders said volatilities in the Atmel options had climbed in the last several days ahead of the earnings but were coming down Thursday.
Most action was seen in the Atmel calls, with the October 35s, the November 40s, 32-1/2s and 35s all trading on big volume.
Investors in Altera options also were taking profits in the options as that stock rallied after it reported an increase in third quarter profits, traders said.
At 1135 CDT (1635 GMT), Altera stock was 5-5/8 up at 59-1/2, off its 60-1/4 session high. Nearly five million shares traded.
"In general customers are selling the options," a trader said, referring to Altera.
The trader said that even though volatilities on the Altera options declined, the stock price movement was so great that the options still looked attractive.
The Altera October 55 call was the most active, with about 550 contracts changing hands. It was up 2-1/4 at 4-5/8.
Other actives included the October 50 call and the November 55 and 60 calls. The October 55 put, down 3-1/16 at 5/16, traded 370 contracts and was the most active put.
Elsewhere, big trades were seen in two Exxon Corp options, the October 85 put and the November 85 put.
The Exxon October 85 put traded just over 2,000 contracts and the November 85 put traded just over 1,000. Exxon shares were off 1/8 at 86.
Michael Schwartz at Oppenheimer & Co in New York said the action could have been a two-to-one spread.
A trader said the strategy was unclear but an investor bought the Octobers and sold the Novembers, rolling a smaller position out another month.
Also, spreads were seen in the Seagate Technology Inc December 40 put, which traded 2,400 contracts. -Gregory Crawford, 312/408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
